hints.title: Initial Score at Index Zero
hints.text: At division index 0, the left partition is empty (zero 0s) and the right partition contains all elements (total sum of ones).

hints.title: Incremental Updates
hints.text: When moving the division index from i to i + 1, if nums[i] is 0, the score increases by 1. If nums[i] is 1, the score decreases by 1.

hints.title: Track Maxima
hints.text: Maintain the maximum score encountered and collect all indices that achieve this maximum.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(N) single pass or optimal algorithmic traversal
variables: N: input size or row count
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recounting 0s and 1s from scratch at each division takes O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Running total updates execute in O(N) time with O(N) space for the resulting index list.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply rolling O(1) state transitions across partition boundaries.
